input.quote: This is IBM's entire obligation to Customer with regard to any claim of infringement.
input.rationale: Section 8.1 gives an IBM indemnity only for third-party IP infringement claims relating to Materials or Base Components, and expressly makes that IBM's entire indemnity obligation; there is no indemnity for IBM's breach of applicable law, data breach caused by IBM, or IBM's gross negligence or wilful misconduct, as the playbook preferred position requires. Conversely, Customer's indemnity in 8.2 is broad, including any Services Recipient claim "related, directly or indirectly, to the Services", which goes well beyond Customer content and Customer breach of law. Notice/control/cooperation procedure already exists (8.1(a)-(b)) and indemnity payments are uncapped under 9.1(a), so the minimal fix is to add the missing IBM prongs and delete 8.2(a)(3).

proposal.summary: Add IBM indemnity for breach of law, data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct; delete Customer's open-ended Services Recipient indemnity.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added IBM indemnities for breach of applicable law, unauthorised access to or disclosure of our data, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct, since Section 8.1 currently covers only IP infringement, and we have deleted Section 8.2(a)(3), which would have us indemnify IBM for any Services Recipient claim relating to the Services. Our position is a full vendor indemnity with our indemnity confined to our content and our breach of law; if helpful, we can discuss capping the new IBM prongs at 3x annual charges.

ops.text: In addition to and independent of IBM's obligations above, IBM will defend, indemnify and hold harmless Customer, its Enterprise and their respective employees, officers, agents and directors from and against any third party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) IBM's breach of applicable law; (ii) any unauthorized access to, or disclosure of, Content or other Customer data caused by IBM, its Affiliates or its Subcontractors; or (iii) IBM's gross negligence or willful misconduct. The conditions in Subsections 8.1(a) and 8.1(b) apply to claims under this Subsection, and the exclusions in Subsections 8.1(1) through 8.1(4) and the statement of IBM's entire obligation above apply only to claims of infringement.
